integrity: The claim is proved by exact Cartesian-product factorization, an epsilon argument for infima, and Fekete's lemma. No numerical experiment is used as proof, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The product construction gives an upper bound but does not determine the exact fixed-cardinality constants in dimensions at least three; the known lower and upper bounds remain widely separated.
title: Cartesian-product submultiplicativity for centroid-alignment efficiency
